tips.text: Keep your clan at Ghost tier; each tier above it multiplies every research cost.
Gather the rare items for the Elytron blueprint research first; the three part researches do not unlock until it finishes.
Start all three part researches the moment the blueprint finishes and farm while the 72-hour timers run.
Farm Polymer at Assur while the timers run, then Nano Spores and Alloy Plate, and leave Cryotic for a boosted group session.
Do not spend Cryotic elsewhere while this is in progress; other farms drain it too.
Cryotic from Excavation is the part everyone dislikes and the one that sets the pace; the rest is bulk with no luck involved.
